title: Longmont Fire Station 2 Open House
description: Meet local firefighters and explore the station during this community open house.

title: Murder Mystery Dinner at Callahan House
description: A 1930s Hollywood-themed interactive murder mystery evening. Registration and tickets required.

title: Longmont Day of the Dead Family Fiesta
description: Free community celebration featuring music, dance, sugar skull decorating, food, crafts, and the Gigantes procession around 2 PM.

title: Noche de Museo: Celebrating Day of the Dead
description: An evening performance celebrating Día de Muertos traditions and music. Check ticket availability with the museum.

title: Halloween Costume Parade & Trick-or-Treat Street
description: Costume parade lines up at 9:30 AM and starts at 10 AM, followed by downtown trick-or-treating at participating businesses. Free and family-friendly.

title: Itty Bitty City Preschool Playtime
description: Indoor playtime for preschool-age children and their caregivers.

title: Free Saturday Fitness at Lanyon Park
description: A free outdoor community fitness session. Check the City calendar for weather and participation details.

title: Longmont Turkey Trot
description: Annual community running and walking event featuring a 10K and 2-mile route. Check registration details with the City.

title: Longmont Ice Pavilion Opening Day
description: Seasonal outdoor ice skating returns to Roosevelt Park. Check admission and session details before visiting.

title: Free Saturday Fitness at Lanyon Park
description: A second free community fitness session at Lanyon Park.

title: Holiday Open House at Callahan House
description: Explore the historic Victorian house decorated for the holidays. Free self-guided visits; no registration required.

title: Santa Visit at Callahan House
description: A seasonal Santa visit in the historic house. Advance registration is required and space is limited.

title: Longmont Lights Holiday Festival
description: Celebrate the holiday season at the City’s Longmont Lights festival in Roosevelt Park.

title: Longmont Lights Holiday Parade
description: Illuminated floats, bands and performers parade through downtown as part of Longmont Lights.
